mapper.sql: SELECT '기업리뷰' AS reviewType, cr.company_review_id AS reviewId, cr.company_id AS companyId, cr.author_user_id AS authorUserId, c.company_name AS companyName, CONCAT(LEFT(u.name, 1), '**') AS authorName, cr.summary AS title, cr.pros AS content, cr.cons AS secondaryContent, cr.overall_rating AS rating, NULL AS interviewType, NULL AS interviewResult, NULL AS difficulty, cr.status, cr.hidden_reason AS hiddenReason, cr.admin_memo AS adminMemo, cr.created_at AS createdAt, cr.updated_at AS updatedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reports r WHERE r.target_type='기업리뷰' AND r.target_id=cr.company_review_id) AS reportCount FROM company_reviews cr JOIN companies c ON c.company_id=cr.company_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id=cr.author_user_id UNION ALL SELECT '면접후기', ir.interview_review_id, ir.company_id, ir.author_user_id, c.company_name, CONCAT(LEFT(u.name, 1), '**'), COALESCE(jp.title, '면접후기'), ir.content, ir.tips, NULL, ir.interview_type, ir.interview_result, ir.difficulty, ir.status, ir.hidden_reason, ir.admin_memo, ir.created_at, ir.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reports r WHERE r.target_type='면접후기' AND r.target_id=ir.interview_review_id) FROM interview_reviews ir JOIN companies c ON c.company_id=ir.company_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id=ir.author_user_id LEFT JOIN job_postings jp ON jp.job_posting_id=ir.job_posting_id

status != '삭제'
AND reviewType = '기업리뷰' AND status = '정상' AND reviewType = '면접후기' AND status = '정상' AND status = '숨김'
AND (companyName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM company_reviews WHERE status != '삭제') AS companyCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interview_reviews WHERE status != '삭제') AS interviewCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reports WHERE target_type IN ('기업리뷰','면접후기') AND status='미처리') AS pendingReportCount

SELECT '기업리뷰' AS reviewType, cr.company_review_id AS reviewId, cr.company_id AS companyId, cr.author_user_id AS authorUserId, c.company_name AS companyName, CONCAT(LEFT(u.name,1),'**') AS authorName, cr.summary AS title, cr.pros AS content, cr.cons AS secondaryContent, cr.overall_rating AS rating, cr.status, cr.hidden_reason AS hiddenReason, cr.admin_memo AS adminMemo, cr.created_at AS createdAt, cr.updated_at AS updatedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reports r WHERE r.target_type='기업리뷰' AND r.target_id=cr.company_review_id) AS reportCount FROM company_reviews cr JOIN companies c ON c.company_id=cr.company_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id=cr.author_user_id WHERE cr.company_review_id=#{reviewId} AND cr.status != '삭제'

SELECT '면접후기' AS reviewType, ir.interview_review_id AS reviewId, ir.company_id AS companyId, ir.author_user_id AS authorUserId, c.company_name AS companyName, CONCAT(LEFT(u.name,1),'**') AS authorName, COALESCE(jp.title,'면접후기') AS title, ir.content, ir.tips AS secondaryContent, ir.interview_type AS interviewType, ir.interview_result AS interviewResult, ir.difficulty, ir.status, ir.hidden_reason AS hiddenReason, ir.admin_memo AS adminMemo, ir.created_at AS createdAt, ir.updated_at AS updatedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reports r WHERE r.target_type='면접후기' AND r.target_id=ir.interview_review_id) AS reportCount FROM interview_reviews ir JOIN companies c ON c.company_id=ir.company_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id=ir.author_user_id LEFT JOIN job_postings jp ON jp.job_posting_id=ir.job_posting_id WHERE ir.interview_review_id=#{reviewId} AND ir.status != '삭제'
mapper.update: UPDATE company_reviews SET status=#{status}, admin_memo=#{memo}, hidden_reason=CASE WHEN #{status}='숨김' THEN #{hiddenReason} ELSE NULL END, hidden_by=CASE WHEN #{status}='숨김' THEN #{adminId} ELSE NULL END, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE company_review_id=#{reviewId} AND status != '삭제'

UPDATE interview_reviews SET status=#{status}, admin_memo=#{memo}, hidden_reason=CASE WHEN #{status}='숨김' THEN #{hiddenReason} ELSE NULL END, hidden_by=CASE WHEN #{status}='숨김' THEN #{adminId} ELSE NULL END, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE interview_review_id=#{reviewId} AND status != '삭제'

UPDATE reports SET status='처리완료', resolution_action='숨김', resolution_note=#{memo}, handled_by=#{adminId}, handled_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE target_type=#{reviewType} AND target_id=#{reviewId} AND status='미처리'
